info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Logistics Shipments Create-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Creation API enables users to initiate the process of creating new logistics shipments within the system. By utilizing this API, businesses can efficiently manage their shipment creation workflows, ensuring accurate shipment data is captured and processed. It is designed for logistics managers, supply chain professionals, and developers who are integrating shipment functionalities into their applications. This operation streamlines the logistics process, helping companies enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer satisfaction.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new shipment by providing the required shipment details. Once the shipment is created, the system will return the shipment information including a unique shipment ID.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new shipment. It should contain all necessary details regarding the shipment such as shipper information, recipient information, shipment contents, and any additional preferences or options.

200.description: The shipment has been successfully created.

priority.description: The priority level of the shipment, where a higher number indicates a higher priority.

amount.description: The monetary amount associated with the shipment.

currency.description: The currency code of the amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether notifications are required for this shipment.

requestedAt.description: The date and time when the shipment was requested.

channel.description: The communication channel used for the shipment request.

recordIndex.description: An index representing the record position of the shipment.
